evidence.description: Report number 25-011301 records the date of incident as Sunday, April 13, 2025, at a sand and gravel company in Northeast Rochester, MN. Officers were dispatched and met the reporting party, who reported the loss of a silver GMC Sierra truck.
Footage, vehicle details beyond the truck description, point of entry, damage, and other evidence are all marked 'not reported'. Items missing are listed as 'truck'.
The report lists time of day and whether the truck was used at a later scene as unknown.
